description.p: Quire is a notepad for plain Markdown files in a folder you choose. It styles notes as you type, saves automatically and links them like a wiki, with backlinks, related notes and search by words and by meaning. Nothing leaves your computer unless you turn on an AI provider.

ul.li: A fast editor that stays smooth on very large files, with multiple cursors
Wikilinks that update when you rename a note, backlinks and unlinked mentions
Boards, tables and calendars built from note properties, still plain Markdown
Ask questions of your notes and get answers with sources, offline
Version history for every note, and safe merging when a sync tool changes a note you're editing
